o1.biggest_strength: Placing the future trip reminder on Screen 2 (post-cancellation) perfectly honors both legal compliance and user trust while completely eliminating wasteful discounts.
o1.biggest_mistake: Could have explicitly addressed what happens if a user clicks 'Cancel' before selecting a reason.

reason: Output 1 delivers an exceptionally clean, sprint-ready specification that eliminates unprofitable discounts and respects our brand by placing post-trip reminders after cancellation is confirmed. Its financial modelling and voice are flawless.
